probe.family: StandardScaler plus balanced RidgeClassifier or Ridge regression

train_gap_subset: within each task take the lexicographically first three TRAIN source groups; retain all rows

controls.different_group: deterministic cyclic candidate from another source group
controls.same_task_wrong_time: deterministic cyclic candidate from the same task and a different episode
controls.reversed_action: reverse raw [27,22] action time, rebuild frozen A0 features, then encode P_a
controls.current_vision: frozen Original UniT current/current path before P_v
controls.reversed_contact: swap frozen Contact-State current/future before frozen C3 and P_c

contact_capability_reliability: paired similarity margin and temporal-control margin have source-group bootstrap CI lower bound greater than zero
